forum.title: NUCLEO-G070RB ADC not working channels 2 to channel 5
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @Chinna651302, to the community!

If you look at the [schematics of the NUCLEO\_G070RB](https://www.st.com/resource/en/schematic_pack/mb1360-g070rb-c02_schematic.pdf), you will see that the associated pins PA2, PA3 and P5 are already in use, but ADC\_IN4 = PA4 is free and should therefore work as an ADC input. Unfortunately, no alternative pins are available for the ADC inputs, so on the NUCLEO you cannot use ADC\_IN2, ADC\_IN3 and ADC\_IN5 without changing the components that are already connected.

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
